cd /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip && git add packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/routes/agents-cf.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(deploy-cloudflare): proxy heartbeat-run + workspace-operation logs to sidecar

GET /api/heartbeat-runs/:runId/log was returning 404 in the CF Worker
even though the run completed and persisted its log file. Cause: the
run-log-store reads from disk via:

  const stat = await fs.stat(filePath).catch(() => null);
  if (!stat) throw notFound(\"Run log not found\");

When fs.stat hits the CF shim it throws \"node:fs/promises.stat not
available in CF Workers\". The .catch swallows that as if the file is
missing, returns 404 to the user, and the auto-fallback never sees the
shim error to retry against the sidecar.

Route both log endpoints (run log + workspace-op log) directly to the
sidecar where the real filesystem exists. Verified GET log now returns
200 with content. The proper long-term fix is an R2-backed run log
store (TODO at the top of run-log-store.ts), but proxying is correct
for the local-dev path and matches how every other fs-bound route
already works.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
